foregroundProfileQueries.basis: Two native chat.send events and successful completion of the source-verified method, which asserts no chat error and exact reply equality for both foreground queries. This is UI/source evidence, not a packet trace.
foregroundProfileQueries.excludedFromCount: Workflow transport/learning/judge probes and any background memory extraction are not included in the two foreground profile queries.

passedAssertions: Actual native profile text equals the generated sentence before save.
Saved profile appears before the first relaunch.
Fresh conversation after relaunch returns exactly the saved random value.
Memory master switch changes from enabled to disabled and has no persistence error.
Another fresh conversation after relaunch returns exactly UNKNOWN.
Profile disabled notice and the actual saved profile both remain present.

keyboardEvidence.interpretation: Native toolbar readiness/visibility assertions passed in this invocation; the earlier toolbar failure did not recur. This does not prove that keyboard introduction caused the earlier failure.

sourceBoundary.scope: Validates manual save, relaunch recall, master-switch gating and retained profile. It does not validate the later history AX fix, all profile UI cases, or model ProfileEdit tool mutations.
